RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the April 22, 2008/Vaisakha 2, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
127
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Threat of global warming
*401. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has geared up to meet
acute water shortage in view of the threat
of global warming;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Capital with FFIs
†*402. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETH-
MALANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that capital of
Foreign Financial Institutions (FFIs) during
the year 2007-08 has constantly increased
upto December, 2007;
(b) if so, the amount of capital brought
in India by these FFIs between April to
June, July to September and October to
December, 2007;
(c) whether it is also a fact that foreign
capital has been collected by respective
institutions during each of the said period;
and
(d) if so, the amount of capital collected
by them during each of the said period?
Rise in inflation rate
*403. SHRI RAMDAS
AGARWAL:
SHRI DARA SINGH:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been able
to check the inflation rate which has touched
a 59-week high of 6.7 per cent as on
15 March, 2008 and inflation is likely to
remain at elevated levels between 6.7 per
cent and 7.4 per cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years on quarterly basis till date;
(c) whether Reserve Bank of India has
apprehended any upward pressure of
inflation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by Government, till date in this regard

128
keeping in view that wholesale price-based
inflation rate has already jumped 1.5
percentage points through first fortnight
of March, 2008?
Funds for the weaker sections
*404. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA
SULE:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI :
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has announced
that it would set up two funds with a total
corpus of Rs. 1,000 crore for greater
financial inclusion of weaker sections of
the society through development work,
each with a corpus of Rs. 500 crore, of
which a maximum of Rs. 200 crore each
would be contributed by the Centre over a
period of five years;
(b) whether during 2007-08, he had
announced constitution of Financial
Inclusion Fund and Financial Inclusion
Technology Fund with an overall corpus
of Rs. 500 crore each with initial funding
from Government, RBI and the NABARD;
and
(c) the extent to which the funds had
been utilised so far?
Involvement of  airlines in human
trafficking
*405. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) is aware that staff
of various airlines are involved in human
trafficking;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
put a check on the activities of staff of
various airlines posted at airports/planes;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Fresh guidelines for recruitment of
loan recovery agents
*406. SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA
A. HEPTULLA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether RBI has issued fresh
guidelines to be followed by the private
banks for recruitment of loan recovery
agents;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
whether these guidelines are drafted in
consultation with the private banks;
(c) how the antecedents of recovery
agents are being verified by the Banks;
(d) what role the State police plays in
this regard; and
(e) how the fresh guidelines are different
from the old guidelines?
Post office savings scheme
*407. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently the
withdrawals from the various post office
savings scheme are more than the deposits,
leading to a negative growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) what is Government's reaction
thereto?

129
Financial restructuring of BHPV
*408. SHRI TA PAN KUMAR
SEN:
SHRI MOHAMMED
AMIN:
 Will the Minister of HEA VY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether a press release from the
Cabinet on financial restructuring of Bharat
Heavy Plates and V essels Ltd. (BHPV) was
uploaded in the PIB website on
26 November, 2007 at 2149 hrs.;
(b) if so, whether the press release
conveyed Government's approval to
proposals, viz. waiver and write off of loans
and interest amounting to Rs. 414.95 crores
upto 31 March, 2007 and settlement of all
outstanding liabilities of BHPV amounting
to Rs. 263.97 crores;
(c) whether the press release was
withdrawn from the PIB website
immedi
